name: t5probe_c2
description: Phase 3 T5 OPTION (ii) -- CANDIDATE C2. Candidate C (iwnd=1 RKW88 + iinit=8 line thermal) re-run with PERIODIC y walls (sbc=nbc=1). C was VOID because its echo spanned all 180 y rows wall to wall in every frame -- and that is not a storm escaping, it is iinit=8's geometry: init3d.F's beta has no y term and no y-extent parameter exists, so the line is infinite in y by construction. Periodic y is the standard along-line configuration for squall-line simulations, under which the same line is the INTENDED setup rather than a containment failure. Namelist-only: no patch, no third binary hash, the CM1 pin does not move. Scored by the UNCHANGED section 8 rule. Prediction on record (docs section 10.4): C2 will still classify SUPERCELL, because C was denied MULTICELL by criterion 1 (frac_rot 0.94), not by criterion 2' (E 20.8) and not by its void.
